title: Mushroom and feta omelette
summary: Low carb with a Mediterranean twist.
steps: Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and pepper. Slice the mushrooms.
Heat the oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat and fry the mushrooms for 4 to 5 minutes until golden. Add the spinach and stir until it wilts.
Spread the vegetables out evenly, turn the heat to medium-low and pour in the eggs. Draw the edges in with a spatula and tilt the pan so the runny egg flows to the sides.
When the top is almost set, after 2 to 3 minutes, crumble over the feta, fold the omelette in half and slide it onto a plate.
